sentences.en: There are certain expressions which are now only used ironically.
sentences.zh: 有些表达现在只能嘲讽地使用了。

sentences.en: Ironically, the fan shop gets really warm in the summer.
sentences.zh: 讽刺的是，这家球迷商店在夏天变得非常热。

sentences.en: Ironically, it was his best friend who arrested him.
sentences.zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，逮捕他的竟然是他最好的朋友。

senses.zh: 嘲讽地, 挖苦地具有讽刺意味地
